name: 07062 · Plainfield, NJ
findings: ZIP 07062 (Plainfield) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07062 (Plainfield) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 10 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07062 (Plainfield) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
